responsibility: This file implements checking-build concrete test classes for GCC's `diagnostic_path` abstraction. It provides selftest-only `diagnostic_event`, `diagnostic_thread`, and `diagnostic_path` implementations backed by vectors of synthetic events and formatted descriptions, with helpers for building call/return/threaded event traces and testing same-function and connection semantics without depending on tree nodes. Its role is diagnostic-path test infrastructure rather than production diagnostic emission.
same_name_distinction: Implements the selftest-only concrete diagnostic-path classes and helper method bodies for building synthetic event/thread traces. In this same-name pair, the .h declares those test classes and their APIs for checking builds.
